title: Functionalization of kaolinite for removal of phosphate from urban sewage
author: Carbinatti, da Conceição, et al.

steps.title: Prepare phosphate solution
steps.instruction: Make an aqueous solution of PO₄³⁻ at an initial concentration (C₀) of 1 mg L⁻¹ and adjust the pH to 6.0.

steps.title: Weigh samples
steps.instruction: Accurately weigh 1.0 g of each kaolinite sample (CK and FK) into separate reaction vessels.

steps.title: Add solution to samples
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL of the prepared PO₄³⁻ solution to each weighed sample and mix gently to obtain a homogeneous suspension.

steps.title: Shake suspension
steps.instruction: Place the vessels on a shaker and agitate at 145 rpm for 24 h at ambient temperature.

steps.title: Centrifuge suspension
steps.instruction: After shaking, centrifuge each suspension at 3000 rpm for 25 min.

steps.title: Collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully decant or pipette the supernatant from each tube without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Measure residual phosphate
steps.instruction: Determine the remaining PO₄³⁻ concentration (Cₑ) in each supernatant using a Hach DR‑2800 spectrophotometer (detection limit 0.1 mg L⁻¹).

steps.title: Calculate removal efficiency
steps.instruction: Compute the phosphate removal efficiency (%A) for each sample using the equation %A = [(C₀ − Cₑ) / Cₑ] × 100.

steps.title: Repeat in triplicate
steps.instruction: Perform the entire procedure (steps 2–7) three independent times for each sample to obtain triplicate data.
